### Better Days — *Fallout: Equestria: Pink Eyes*

**Who:** Captain Better Days is the late husband of Rainy Days and father of Puppysmiles in mimezinga's *Fallout Equestria: Pink Eyes*. He is remembered through an especially sad scene: Puppysmiles keeps bringing gifts to his grave, believing he might eventually come home.

**Name and continuity:** “Better Days” is written on his grave as **Captain Better Days**, so it is a name used within this fan-created story, not merely a wiki nickname. He is not a *Friendship Is Magic* TV character. Do not confuse him with *Fallout Equestria: Better Days*, Gamma Deekay's separate story starring the bounty hunter Percussion Cap.

**Recognizable details:** Chapter 16, “Reunions,” shows his white gravestone at the Interequestrian 52 War Cemetery, engraved with a **two-keys cutie mark**. Puppysmiles left Pinkie Pie and Rainbow Dash plastic figures there. His military rank and grave establish him as a fallen soldier; his coat color, mane, pony type and living appearance are **not verified**.

**Speaking/appearances:** Mentioned and memorialized rather than shown speaking in the verified chapter. No attributable dialogue, animated episode appearance, or verified voice actor. “Captain” is a rank, not a secret identity.

**Primary sources:** [*Pink Eyes*, chapter 16 (mimezinga)](https://www.fimfiction.net/story/931/16/fallout-equestria-pink-eyes/chapter-16-reunions); [the distinct *Better Days* story (Gamma Deekay)](https://www.fimfiction.net/story/124940/1/fallout-equestria-better-days/chapter-1-not-so-humble-beginings).

**Contextual fan artwork, not a portrait of Better Days:** Puppysmiles, his daughter, by **Cazra** (original artist); **booruimporter** uploaded the Manebooru copy. [![Puppysmiles by Cazra](https://static.manebooru.art/img/2020/10/17/2178141/full.png)](https://manebooru.art/images/2178141)
